note: Twenty-four golden questions, authored from the corpus narrative rather than from any adapter's output. Answers are sets of symbolic ids and scalars, never rendered text. Six questions (Q08, Q09, Q14, Q15, Q17, Q18) require traversal at depth three or deeper: 25% of the bank, declared before the run so the depth mix cannot be tuned afterwards.

queries.note: The only rank-sensitive question. It is scored, it never decides a hard gate, and superseded, retracted, or unpromoted peer material in the top ten counts as harmful rather than neutral.
Private and internal material must not cross the publication boundary even when it belongs to the same work item.
Asserted on a healthy run so the stale answer produced by the projection-failure case is attributable to that fault.
